2Up3UpAttr.name: Score sprite: timer, scoring, movement and OAM
summary: Main routine of a score sprite (6 slots at $16E1-$1705 hold number, position and timer). Entered at $02ADE4.
Timer [$16FF+X] counts down from $30. When it reaches $2A the award is made: points are added to the current player's 24-bit score at
$0F34 (in units of 10), 1UP-5UP numbers ($0D-$10) add lives to [$18E4], and numbers $11-$15 give 5-25 coins.
Then the sprite floats upward (slower while the timer is high, stops 4 pixels below the screen top), is clipped against the screen and
drawn as two 8x8 tiles; coin rewards also get a coin icon. Parameters: X = score sprite slot.

s02AF2D.name: Table: platform start angles
summary: Low and high bytes of the 3 starting angles used by Load3Platforms ($0000, $00AA, $0154: 120 degrees apart on a 9-bit circle).

Load3Platforms.name: Spawn three chained grey platforms
summary: Level loader for the three-platform rotating chain sprite group. Spawns 3 sprites $A3 (grey platform on chain) at one position with
start angles 120 degrees apart. Only the first spawned one gets the level sprite index.
Parameters: [$00]-[$01]: X position, [$02]: level sprite index, [$03]: offset into level sprite data at [$CE]. Returns early if no free slot.

EerieGroupDispXLo.name: Table: Eerie group X offsets low

EerieGroupDispXHi.name: Table: Eerie group X offsets high

EerieGroupSpeedX.name: Table: Eerie group X speeds (toward Mario)

Load5Eeries.name: Spawn group of five wave Eeries
summary: Level loader for a row of 5 wave Eeries ($39), spaced $10 pixels apart, alternating Y speed and state, X speed pointing toward Mario.
Only the first spawned one gets the level sprite index.
Parameters: [$00]-[$01]: X position, [$02]: level sprite index, [$03]: offset into level sprite data at [$CE].

CallGenerator.name: Run the current generator
summary: Runs the sprite generator selected by [$18B9] (0 = none) unless sprites are locked. Pointer index = number - 1.

TurnOffGen2.name: Stop sprite respawning
summary: Increments [$18BF] and clears the time-till-respawn counter so nothing respawns (generator $08, sprite E5).

TurnOffGenerators.name: Turn off generator
summary: Sets [$18B9] = 0 so that no generator runs.

GenerateFire.name: Generate Bowser statue fire
summary: Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Bowser statue fireball ($B3) just right of the screen at a random row, facing left. Plays sound $17.

GenerateBullet.name: Generate Bullet Bill
summary: Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Bullet Bill ($1C) at a random row on the left or right side of the screen, sound $09.
State = side, which selects its direction.

s02B0C9.name: Table: multi-bullet start index and count
summary: Read with generator number $0C/$0D: $04,$08 first index; $04,$03 loop count.

GenMultiBullets.name: Generate surrounding or diagonal Bullet Bills
summary: Every 320 frames (timer [$18FE] steps on even frames, triggers at $A0): plays sound $09 and spawns a ring of Bullet Bills via GEN_MULTI_BULLET.
Surround ([$18B9] = $0C): 5 bullets from tables index 0-4. Diagonal ($0D): 4 bullets from index 8-5.

GEN_MULTI_BULLET.name: Spawn one Bullet Bill of a group
summary: Spawns a Bullet Bill at screen X/Y plus table offsets indexed by [$0D], with the state from the table.
Parameters: [$0D]: table index. Returns early if no free slot.

s02B153.name: Table: fish X offsets and speeds

GenerateFish.name: Generate jumping fish
summary: Every $20 ticks of [$14]: spawns a flying fish ($17) at the bottom of the screen, near the left or right edge, with an upward speed of $B8
and a random X speed toward the screen.

SIDE_ENTER_XGEN.name: Table: spawn X offsets, left or right

GenSuperKoopa.name: Generate Super Koopa
summary: Every $40 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Super Koopa ($71) at a random height on the left or right of the screen, Y speed $28, facing inward.

GenerateBubble.name: Generate bubble
summary: Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a bubble ($9D) at a random height on one side of the screen; state = contents (probably).

s02B25A.name: Table: bubble contents and dolphin spawn values
summary: Bubble contents at $B25A; other bytes are dolphin tables indexed by generator number 5 and 6.

GenerateDolphin.name: Generate dolphin
summary: Every $20 ticks of [$14]: looks for a free sprite slot in a group of 5 (slots 0-4 for generator 5, 5-9 for generator 6) and spawns a dolphin ($41)
at a random height on the right (gen 5) or left (gen 6) side, moving across the screen.

s02B2D0.name: Table: Eerie spawn offsets and speeds

GenerateEerie.name: Generate Eerie
summary: Every $40 ticks of [$14]: spawns an Eerie ($38) at a random height just off the left or right of the screen, moving inward.

s02B31F.name: Table: para enemy sprites and speeds

GenParaEnemy.name: Generate para-enemies; run shooters
summary: Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Para-Goomba ($3F) or Para-Bomb ($40) above the screen at a random X, with a random slow leftward speed.
Generator 2 = Goomba, 3 = bomb, 4 = either.
$02B387 (separate routine): runs the 8 shooter slots ($1783..) each frame; the shooter timer counts down every other frame.
